## 2. Per-category observations and recommended iteration

### TECHNICAL_LAYER_1 — Layer 1 too technical for non-technical roles

**Description.** MVE Layer 1 (the WHY layer) uses jargon or feature names that
non-technical operators (nurses, biomed engineers) cannot parse.
Operationalised as low SHAP-feature surface rate in Layer 1
(all_3_present in rq2_mve_shap_alignment.json) and as qualitative
themes mentioning vocabulary/jargon.

**Observations:** 1  
**Status:** `observed_not_fixed`  
**Impact metric:** User study confidence score (RQ2.c per-role confidence)

**Recommended iteration (future work):**

> Simplify vocabulary post-Mode-A generation; map raw feature names to
> role-appropriate phrasings (e.g., 'fwd_pkts_tot' → 'outbound data
> volume' for nurses). Re-run alignment metric to verify SHAP features
> still surface in simplified form. Round 2 evaluation required.

**Sample evidence:**

- *results/rq2_mve_shap_alignment.json* — fusion_class=BENIGN (n=16): only 0% of alerts surface all 3 top SHAP features in Layer 1 (threshold 50%). Proxy for Layer-1 jargon/vocabulary gap.

### MITRE_NOT_REFERENCED — MITRE technique not referenced or not understood

**Description.** Layer 1 fails to reference the mapped MITRE technique (T-ID or human
name), or references it without sufficient context for the reader to
understand what it means.

**Observations:** 0  
**Status:** `no_observations_collected`  
**Impact metric:** MITRE grounding rate (rq2_mitre_grounding.json::headline.grounded_pct)

**Recommended iteration (future work):**

> Add plain-language gloss alongside T-IDs (e.g., 'T1071 (command-and-
> control communication)'). Strengthen Mode A prompt to require both
> T-ID and human name. Re-run grounding metric.

*No observations of this type collected.*

### DO_NOT_IGNORED — DO_NOT clinical-safety actions ignored or under-emphasized

**Description.** Layer 3 DO_NOT constraints (e.g., 'do not disconnect ventilator')
are present but not visually emphasized; operator overlooks them in
study or skips the constraint when reporting action_taken.

**Observations:** 0  
**Status:** `no_observations_collected`  
**Impact metric:** User study accuracy on CRITICAL+clinical-device alerts (RQ2.c per-role accuracy)

**Recommended iteration (future work):**

> Visual emphasis in UI for DO_NOT (red badge, separate block, required
> acknowledgement before submission). UI change, not generator change.
> Re-run study with new UI.

*No observations of this type collected.*

### ROLE_VIEW_MISMATCH — Role view inappropriate for participant background

**Description.** A participant assigned a role view (per self-selection or assignment)
reports the explanation didn't match their actual operational mental
model — or two participants in different roles disagree about what
the alert means despite a shared anchor.

**Observations:** 0  
**Status:** `no_observations_collected`  
**Impact metric:** User study per-role differentiation (RQ2.c per-role accuracy gap)

**Recommended iteration (future work):**

> Better role inference at study signup (e.g., short skill survey
> instead of self-selection). For deployment: integrate with hospital
> identity provider to derive role from job title. Re-run study with
> better role assignment.

*No observations of this type collected.*
